headline: Water committee defers Bill 108 on USGS water monitoring agreement

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The committee discussed Bill 108 (2025), a joint funding agreement with USGS for Oct. 1, 2025 to Sept. 30, 2026 that also funds a West Maui monitoring well site study. The chair deferred the item; the bill still needs second and final reading.
meeting.recap: Members held a moment of silence for a Maui Police Department officer killed in the line of duty.[[0:00:52]] The bill would let the mayor sign a joint funding agreement from October 1, 2025 to September 30, 2026.[[0:06:30]] The bill passed first reading on August 12, 2025, and still needs a second and final reading.[[0:07:33]] The agreement also funds phase one of a study to pick a site for a deep monitoring well in West Maui.[[0:09:13]] The representative said two proposed exploratory wells in West Maui could someday become production wells to meet demand.[[0:11:48]] The representative said today's water demand includes rebuilding burned structures.[[0:15:52]] Data from the rain gauge, stream gauge and well stations under the USGS contract is posted live on the USGS website.[[0:26:30]] The representative said the state water commission is not yet reviewing new water use permits.[[0:27:32]] The chair deferred the item, which means it was set aside for now.[[0:33:13]]
meeting.next: Bill 108 (2025) remains with the Council for second and final reading. Written testimony will continue to be accepted into the record.

moments.q: Moment of silence for a Maui Police Department officer
Chair introduces Bill 108 and the USGS agreement
"It's not really proposed to ever be transformed into a production well."
Status of state water use permits

issues.oneLine: The County wants to renew a joint funding agreement with USGS to keep monitoring water resources.
issues.why: The representative said a monitoring well would give better information about the water and hydrology of a West Maui aquifer.

deadlines.t: Start of the USGS joint funding agreement period, which runs to September 30th, 2026.

issues.next: Bill 108 (2025) remains with the Council for second and final reading.
issues.brief: The water department plans to operate and maintain the new gauge in fiscal year 26.[[#1]] One exploratory well could produce about 0.7 million gallons a day.[[#2]] No new monitoring wells are proposed for East Maui.[[#3]]
